description: Phase 2 (Control) design-match fixes in the Compose screen app/src/main/java/dev/autobridge/ui/ControlScreen.kt (fixes 1-8 from the audit). Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 — touches only ControlScreen.kt plus new EN/TH strings. Uses ComposeTokens (ComposeTheme.kt) for all colors; introduce no new color/radius values.
steps: Fix 1 — History icon glyph. In ControlScreen() (~line 193-196) the PhoneHeader action is HeaderButton("↺", stringResource(R.string.control_history_action), onOpenHistory). Change the glyph string "↺" to a clock glyph "🕘" (or "⏱"). This is a Compose Text glyph in RoundGlyph; no vector asset needed. Keep the string resource and onClick unchanged.

Fix 3 + Fix 4 — 'On the car' eyebrow uppercase and domain-first order. In OnTheCarCard() (~line 700-760): (a) the eyebrow Text currently builds stringResource(R.string.control_on_the_car) + " · " + engineLabel(context, state.engine); wrap the whole string in .uppercase() so it renders 'ON THE CAR · BROWSER'. (b) The 'detail' buildString currently appends playbackLabel first then displayHost. Reorder so the domain (state.source.displayHost) comes first, then the playback label, producing 'm.youtube.com · Playing · 0:12 / 3:40'. Keep the time-appending logic for durationMs > 0.

Fix 2 — QUICK ACTIONS horizontal chip row. Replace the quickCommands.chunked(3).forEach { item { Row { ... QuickCard ... } } } block (~line 258-277 in ControlScreen) with a single item { } containing a LazyRow (import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyRow and items) with horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), rendering each quick command as a NEW pill-chip composable (not the 84dp-tall QuickCard). Add a private composable QuickChip(icon, label, removable, onRemove, onClick) styled like SegmentChip: a Surface with RoundedCornerShape(18.dp) (chips radius token range), CardAltColor fill, horizontal icon+label layout, accent icon, with the Edit-mode remove 'x' badge preserved. Keep routing through AutoBridgeCommandBus.send(...) exactly as today.

Fix 5 — Remove RemoteStreamCard. Delete the line item { RemoteStreamCard() } (~line 314) AND delete the entire private @Composable fun RemoteStreamCard() (~line 965). Also remove the now-unused import of dev.autobridge.remotestream.RemoteStreamConfig if nothing else references it (verify with a search before removing the import).

Fix 6 — Tab selection becomes text tab + blue underline. The Queue/Recent/Favorites tabs row (~line 283) currently reuses SegmentChip (a filled pill). Replace it with a new private composable UnderlineTab(label, selected, onClick) that renders the label as plain text (color = Accent when selected else TextMuted) with a 2dp accent underline Box shown only when selected. Keep the inline count badge logic: Queue label stays "$label · ${queue.size}" when the queue is non-empty. The mode toggle (Open/search ↔ Type) at ~line 210 KEEPS using SegmentChip — only the Queue/Recent/Favorites tabs change to underline style.

Fix 7 + Fix 8 — Queue/Recent/Favorites rows: leading thumbnail + overflow menu. Rework the private LinkRow composable (~line 920). (a) Add a leading thumbnail slot: a 40dp RoundedCornerShape(12.dp) Box; if a logo/favicon URL is available use it, otherwise a placeholder colored square filled with ComposeTokens.AccentSoft (or a tint of Accent) showing the first letter of the title. LinkRow currently has no artwork param — add an optional artworkUrl: String? = null param; queue/recent/favorites callers pass null (no URL available there), so a colored placeholder square is the expected render. (b) Replace the two TextButtons (Send + action) with a single '⋯' overflow IconButton that opens a DropdownMenu (import androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuItem) containing two items: Send (onClick) and the action label (onAction, e.g. Remove/Queue). Keep the same onClick/onAction lambdas and string resources (bridge_controller_send, and the passed actionLabel).

Add new EN strings to app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml under the Control section (near control_title): control_queue_overflow ("More actions") for the '⋯' button content description. Reuse existing bridge_controller_send and the passed actionLabel for menu items. Add matching TH strings to app/src/main/res/values-th/strings.xml.
Build and confirm the Compose module compiles and all unit tests still pass.
acceptance_criteria: History header button renders a clock glyph, not ↺.
Quick Actions is a single horizontally-scrolling LazyRow of pill chips (not a 3-column grid of tall cards).
'On the car' eyebrow renders uppercase; the detail line shows domain before the 'Playing' word.
No RemoteStreamCard composable or its item{} remains in the file.
Queue/Recent/Favorites selected tab shows a blue underline (text tab), with the Queue count badge preserved.
Queue/Recent/Favorites rows have a leading thumbnail/placeholder square and a single '⋯' overflow menu with Send + action items.
New strings exist in BOTH values/strings.xml and values-th/strings.xml; no existing string was renamed or removed.
No new color/radius literals introduced — only ComposeTokens values used.
verification: grep to confirm RemoteStreamCard is fully removed from ControlScreen.kt
Confirm every new <string> name added to values/strings.xml also exists in values-th/strings.xml
findings: All 8 Control-screen fixes applied in app/src/main/java/dev/autobridge/ui/ControlScreen.kt. New private composables added: QuickChip(icon, label, removable, onRemove, onClick) — pill chip replacing QuickCard in a horizontal LazyRow for Quick Actions; UnderlineTab(label, selected, onClick) — plain-text tab with 2dp accent underline replacing SegmentChip for Queue/Recent/Favorites (count badge '$label · ${queue.size}' preserved on QUEUE). LinkRow now takes an optional `artworkUrl: String? = null` param (callers pass null → colored AccentSoft placeholder square showing the title's first letter) and uses a single '⋯' overflow IconButton -> DropdownMenu with Send + action items instead of two TextButtons. History header glyph changed '↺' -> '🕘'. 'On the car' eyebrow now .uppercase(); detail line reordered to domain-first (displayHost · playbackLabel · time). RemoteStreamCard composable and its item{} fully removed; unused RemoteStreamConfig import removed. New string key added (EN + TH): control_queue_overflow (EN 'More actions' / TH 'การทำงานเพิ่มเติม') for the overflow button content description. Menu items reuse existing bridge_controller_send and the passed actionLabel. Note: the old QuickCard composable remains defined but is now unused (harmless dead code); the mode toggle still uses SegmentChip as required. Build + unit tests green: ./gradlew testPersonalDebugUnitTest assemblePersonalDebug -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
